description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Approve or reject an action your company is waiting on (listed in company_status approvals): spending, a real-money trade, submitting a bug report to the bug bounty, submitting a Build it Better request, publishing. Nothing in that list happens until you approve it. REST twin: POST /api/v1/company/{id}/approvals/{approval_id}.
